payload.title: Five end-to-end walkthrough specs
payload.description:
One narrative feature file per use case, run against the real records with fakes only at the provider edge: the weekly Distinctive Mark email; the weekly Machines on Machines newsletter (hard review, reviewed sources); the daily Machines on Machines summary; the every-new-item subscription; and 'announced right away, then massaged' (the learning loop). Each follows the walkthrough in the architecture document, from the timer or change to the Today line, including nobody acting, a correction and a duplicate trigger.

**Acceptance criteria**
- All five pass using the same records and agent standard, with only list and policy data differing.
- Each includes the nobody-acts path.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- walkthrough-weekly-distinctive.feature; walkthrough-weekly-mom.feature; walkthrough-daily-mom.feature; walkthrough-every-item.feature; walkthrough-announce-then-massage.feature.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Newsletters and subscriptions: weekly, daily and every new item. Slice code N9 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
